integrity: The lower endpoint follows from separate endpoint controls on the negative and positive second moments after centering. The upper endpoint follows from the covariance representation of mean absolute deviation and Cauchy--Schwarz at the actual mean cut. Equality, nonattainment, boundary approximation, and interval filling are proved analytically; exact-rational computation is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The theorem fixes a finite positive atom-probability profile and varies only the distinct ordered support locations.
The absolute deviation is taken about the arithmetic mean, not about a median or quantile.
Older finite-population, moment-inequality, or isotonic-cone literature may contain an equivalent profile-specific norm comparison.
title: Exact fixed-profile range of mean absolute deviation relative to standard deviation
